title: Belgian mFRR capacity auction awards aggregated per delivery block and direction.
transformation_notes: Sources: ODS055 (individual mFRR capacity bids up to 19/05/2026) and ODS206 (as of 20/05/2026). Only the standard mFRR product is used (mFRR Flex was discontinued on 22/05/2024; its rows are ignored). Elia procures mFRR capacity in the upward direction only. Where both cover a delivery day, ODS206 wins.
One row per delivery block (4 hours, Europe/Brussels local time, converted to UTC; 3/5 hours on DST-change days) and direction (up/down). Prices are capacity prices in EUR/MW/h (pay-as-bid).

Bids whose delivery period spans several 4-hour blocks (e.g. '0 - 24' daily bids) deliver in every block they cover, so they are counted in each covered block; awarded_mw_multi_block shows that share.

awarded_mw = sum of awarded MW; vwap_eur_per_mw_h = awarded-volume-weighted average bid price; marginal_eur_per_mw_h = highest awarded bid price; n_bids = number of bids with awarded MW > 0; offered_mw / n_offered_bids describe all offered bids (selected or not) delivering in the block; they are null where the source lists awarded bids only (ODS055, i.e. mFRR before 2026-05-20).
Gate-2 bids ('G2' suffix in capacitybiddeliveryperiod) are treated like other bids of their period.
